keyFindings.description: When a connection event lands during the open, open moves the new store to the latest connection with store.Reopen and, on failure, only logs and still returns true. The retry ends, reconnect already returned nil for that event, and the store stays on the replaced, closed connection, so the routes fail until another connection event that a healthy connection never brings. Fix: on a Reopen failure store the unavailable state and return false so the retry opens again; correct the comment at :111-114.

close cancels the retry's context but openBucket takes none, so a drain that starts during an open waits up to its 10 s, and can eat the drain's hook reserve so conn.Drain passes its deadline. Fix: close calls r.stop() without waiting (an open finishing later only stores state), or pass a context into legionagents.Open.

roundTwoFixesVerified: registry open retried in the background with a backoff and at once after a reconnect; first open synchronous, one retry goroutine, no lost wakeup (conn/state ordering); log and 503 no longer blame only the grant
